_doc: Copy to config/buffer-channels.json. Get channel IDs by running: node scripts/schedule-buffer.js --list-channels (or Buffer Publish > channel settings). Phase 0 onboarding can fill this for you.
notes: Buffer uses the OIDC token API at api.buffer.com (GraphQL). v1 REST at bufferapp.com is deprecated for these tokens. Token: Buffer Publish > Account > Apps > Create Access Token.
